about: Each one-loop term of the galaxy power spectrum P_gg, in percent of the linear-bias model b_1^2 P_mm (P_mm halofit), for four DESI-like tracers at the co-evolution biases: b_1 = B_g/D(z), b_2 from the Lazeyras et al. fit, b_{s^2} = -(4/7)(b_1 - 1), b_3nl = (32/315)(b_1 - 1). Terms in the CCL convention: b1b2 = b_1 b_2 P_d1d2, b2b2 = b_2^2/4 P_d2d2, b1bs2 = b_1 b_{s^2} P_d1s2, b2bs2 = b_2 b_{s^2}/2 P_d2s2, bs2bs2 = b_{s^2}^2/4 P_s2s2, b1b3nl = b_1 b_3nl sigma_3^2 P_lin, tidal = b1bs2 + b2bs2 + bs2bs2, loop_sum = all six; counterterm = alpha_0 k^2 P_lin(k, z) at the DESI DR1 one-sigma width alpha_0 = 12.5 (Mpc/h)^2. FAST-PT templates at z = 0 scaled by D^4, low-k constants kept (sub_lowk off). k in h/Mpc at the tracer redshift; at_text_k holds the values at the wavenumbers of text_k_h_per_mpc. Written by ../make_figure_data.py.

setup.growth: evolution of the k = 0.05/Mpc mode (CAMB delta_tot)
